summary: Iteration 14 polish tasks — ALL 4 FEATURES PASS across 8 review scenarios. (1) Font default: font-size-value shows 16 immediately post-login, --reader-font-size CSS var = 16px. (2) Swipe-to-switch removed: a full-width horizontal mouse drag across mode-workspace body did NOT flip activeMode — toolbar-mode-collaborate stayed highlighted, toolbar-mode-analyze remained inactive. (3) Universal passage sharing: pasted the locker-room passage into mode-passage-view under Analyze; hopping to Interpret, Revise, Collaborate, Evolution — the SAME string was prefilled in every mode's passage view. Persists via localStorage key scribecraft_passage_shared. (4a) Per-Jupiter-bubble Save as scene: mode-turn-assistant-1-save is present after Interpret run; clicking triggers window.prompt('Name this scene:'), accepting persists a new scene ('Locker Room Interpretation' / auto-title) — 'Saved as scene' toast + new INTERPRET session row appears in sidebar. (4b) Edit Jupiter bubble in place: mode-turn-assistant-1-edit reveals mode-turn-assistant-1-edit-input prefilled with the reply markdown; appending ' (edited)' and clicking mode-turn-assistant-1-edit-save updates the bubble and re-shows the pencil affordance. (4c) Regenerate from user-0 (passage bubble): mode-turn-user-0-regen clears the current reply and streams a FRESH Jupiter reply into mode-turn-assistant-1 (no '(edited)' marker survives), mode-passage-view content unchanged. (4d) Edit + regenerate follow-up: sent follow-up 'What about the smell of chlorine?', received mode-turn-assistant-3. Clicked mode-turn-user-2-edit, changed to 'And the smell of cheap deodorant?', saved. Clicked mode-turn-user-2-regen — mode-turn-assistant-3 replaced with a new, different-content reply (visibly discusses 'deodorant').
critical_code_review_comments: editTurnAt on a Jupiter bubble writes the edited text back into the mode's output string using serializeTurns, so an edit becomes indistinguishable from a fresh Jupiter reply at the transport level — subsequent regen of the same turn will operate on the edited text (fine for this iteration but worth documenting for writers who might expect the original to be preserved).
saveTurnAsScene uses window.prompt which is a browser-native modal — inconsistent with the app's otherwise custom UI. Consider a styled dialog for consistency and mobile UX.

The swipe-to-switch removal is verified, but the workspace root no longer has any horizontal swipe handling at all — if product wants left-swipe-to-go-back-to-sidebar on mobile, that will need to be re-added as an explicit non-mode gesture.

regenerateFromTurn on the passage bubble calls setOutputForMode('') then run(), while regenerate on a follow-up user bubble streams into a preserved-prior-turns transcript. These two code paths are close-but-not-identical — a future refactor could unify them to reduce drift risk.
seed_data_creation: Created two new Interpret history sessions during testing ('Chlorine and Cheap Deodor...' auto-titled, plus a saved scene from the per-bubble Save flow). Safe to leave; identical to prior iteration test artifacts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All four iter-14 polish tasks verified. Font default 16 confirmed via font-size-value textContent and --reader-font-size CSS var. Swipe suppression verified with a full 800px mouse drag across mode-workspace — no mode change. Shared passage confirmed across all 5 modes via input_value() comparison. Per-bubble save/edit/regen work on both assistant and user bubbles, including the special passage-bubble regen path (calls run() fresh) and follow-up regen path (preserves prior turns, streams new assistant reply). No console errors observed during exercise (except pre-auth 401s on initial GET /api/auth/me which is the known iter-13 minor).
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested features working as specified.
